legacy_benchmark.source: Train on Main.xlsx supplied by user; 811 pre-2026 main-field draws; used offline only as legacy structural/algorithm stress-test data, not as an active HEPS dependency.
legacy_benchmark.holdout_sampling: 98 targets, every third draw from 2023-01-01 through 2025-10-17
legacy_benchmark.oracle_condition: Each 18-number test pool contains the true five-number target plus 13 highest-ranked target-blind distractors. Winner identities are used only to guarantee recall; their pre-draw scores are not changed.
legacy_benchmark.interpretation: Most score-ranked assemblers underperformed the matched-random 10-line conditional 3+ rate. This rejects the idea that more elaborate scoring alone solves assembly when candidate-level evidence is weak.

combinatorial_coverage.theorem: With a uniform posterior over all 5-subsets of a frozen candidate pool, choosing any 10 distinct exact lines gives the same exact-5 probability 10/C(n,5). Coverage optimization can improve 3+/4+ overlap, not exact 5/5, unless coalition probabilities are genuinely non-uniform.

jul31_frozen_pool_diagnostic.candidate_recall: 5/5 in the conversational frozen hierarchy; this hierarchy is not currently reproduced by the repository's executable candidate generator.

coulomb_pair_pair_anchor.interpretation: Pair-of-pairs plus anchor logic narrowed the true coalition sharply versus all C(17,5)=6188 combinations, but still did not place the exact line in the top 10.

role_compression_14.warning: The same 14-number compression degraded historical holdout recall and is therefore a prospective challenger only, not an accepted rule.

recommendation.name: posterior_hypergraph_plus_maximum_coverage
stages: Preserve expert-specific node evidence rather than averaging experts into one score.
Score pair/hyperedge interactions with separately validated factors such as stale-hot/void coupling, expert complementarity and structural compatibility.
Construct a posterior over five-number coalitions with a non-zero uniform floor so minority scenarios survive.
Select the final 10-line portfolio by maximum posterior mass coverage of 3+ overlaps, with secondary 4+ and exact-line terms.
Run prospective ablations against matched random and the current lane allocator before any core merge.
